scope: All 28 owned pairs only; no global structural or identity approval

pairJudgments.rationale: Han Shou’s wife 賈午 in Jinshu053 s0035 is the empress’s sister in the same prince marriage/conspiracy network in Jinshu031 s0530,s0581; compare the fully explicit spouse and sister bridge also preserved across the Han Shou packet. The 031 execution passage continues this named Jia Wu with Zhao Can.
Near-verbatim prince marriage episode: 壽妻賈午及后皆不聽 in ZZT083 s0129 and Jinshu053 s0035. Same husband, empress, rejected match and Wang daughter replacement.

ZZT083 s0260 execution of 趙粲、賈午 after deposition of the empress bridges via Jinshu031 s0599 (趙粲、賈午…伏誅), whose same Jia Wu participates with Zhao Can in the crown-prince plot. This connects the event-only endpoint through the complete 031 endpoint evidence, not through name alone.

蒋均, the male Leiyang property litigant with brothers in Houhanshu084 s0251,s0254, is not 蔣俊 the crown-prince’s female consort. Specific Chinese identity names, sex/family context and Han versus Jin narrative differ.

Jinshu004 s0024 蔣俊 is the 中書令 executed with Yang Jun, whereas Jinshu053 s0017,s0065 identifies a female consort/太子保林 whose later interrogation belongs to the crown-prince deposition. Same characters do not overcome distinct sex, office and death episodes.

太子保林蔣俊 in Jinshu053 s0065 and 虨母保林蔣俊 in ZZT083 s0196 are executed together with the prince’s mother Xie in the same deposition event; s0017 independently supplies the prince’s favored consort Jiang bearing a son.

Jinshu024 s0164 names 宦者董猛 appointed 中常侍 by Emperor Hui in 元康中. This is compatible with the Yellow Gate official in Jinshu053, and the broader eunuch career is plausible, but no shared appointment, explicit identity linkage, kinship or matching event ties this endpoint to the target. Preserve uncertainty rather than infer a unique eunuch career.

Jinshu031 s0582,s0583 identifies court eunuch Dong Meng as a trusted East Palace servant of the empress, involved in her coups; s0599 gives his execution with Jia Wu. Jinshu053 s0058,s0060 has the same named Yellow Gate official carrying the empress’s forged direction in the prince’s downfall. Distinctive palace function and same empress/coup network bridge these records.
Nearly verbatim paired passages: 黃門令董猛 displaying the prince’s letter in the Shiqian Hall and the empress having him forge 長廣公主辭 (Jinshu053 s0058,s0060; ZZT083 s0185,s0191).

ZZT083 s0274 executes 董猛 among 劉振、孫慮、程據 after the empress’s fall; Jinshu031 s0599 independently links this Dong Meng’s execution to Jia Wu and the empress’s palace network, which bridges the target and this event-only endpoint.

Jinshu031 s0571 and ZZT083 s0159 explicitly identify the empress’s 妹夫韓壽 and his son 慰祖; Jinshu053 s0034,s0035 gives the same Han Shou’s wife 賈午 and the empress’s family marriage policy. Specific wife/sister and family constellation is a bridge.
Same proposed daughter marriage, Han surname match, wife 賈午, rejection by wife and empress, and substitution of Wang Yan’s daughter (Jinshu053 s0034,s0035; ZZT083 s0128,s0129).

ZZT083 s0159 repeats Jinshu031 s0571’s 妹夫韓壽子慰祖 adoption/substitution narrative; this connects through the same empress’s sister/wife Jia Wu relation in the target. No new merge of an unrelated name-only endpoint is inferred.

ZZT097 s0074g,s0085–s0085c is the Former Yan 左長史 campaigning with Murong Huang in Koguryo decades after the Western Jin empress-family Han Shou’s execution in Jinshu031 s0599. This also respects the existing separation of the target from Jinshu109:p051, another Former Yan Han Shou; it does not newly merge the Yan endpoints.

Jinshu003 s0415 attests 太醫司馬程據 presenting a robe under Emperor Wu, while the target is 太醫令 under Empress Jia. Same specific name and medical bureau with a plausible 22-year career is suggestive, but no promotion, family, retrospective identification or shared episode bridges the earlier official. No conflicting identity is proven either.

Jinshu031 s0560 names 太醫令程據 in Jia’s inner-court misconduct; the same specific medical office and empress association bridge Jinshu053 s0119’s 太醫令程據 receiving her poison commission, with compatible time and no conflicting claims.
ZZT083 s0068 and Jinshu031 s0560 closely parallel the same 太醫令程據 and Empress Jia episode, linking this endpoint through the physician’s same office and patron to Jinshu053 s0119.
Jinshu053 s0119,s0131 and ZZT083 s0236,s0274 share Empress Jia’s named 太醫令 preparing poison for the heir and subsequent execution with Liu Zhen and Sun Lü. Direct event bridge.

楊毖, son of 楊濟 accompanying the Jin crown prince (Jinshu053 s0205), has a different specific given name from 楊璧 named with Mao Xing/Wang Tong in Former Qin’s military network (Jinshu115 s0041). No textual variant or career bridge; different generation and political setting.
Jinshu115 s0052,s0053 identifies 楊璧 as 南秦州刺史/征南大將軍 in Fu Pi’s regime; the target is 楊濟息毖, a Jin East Palace companion. Different Chinese name, polity and generation support distinct people.
Jinshu115 s0183 楊璧 is Fu Deng’s 司空、梁州牧; the target is 楊濟’s son 毖 in the earlier Jin crown prince’s circle. Specific Chinese names and dynastic/generational contexts differ.
Jinshu115 s0218,s0221 楊璧 is Fu Deng’s 大將軍留守仇池; the target is 楊濟息毖. Different specific name and much later Former Qin setting, without any variant-name linkage.

Houhanshu088 s0260 names 博士羊弼, He Xiu’s teacher. Both surname and given-name characters differ from 楊濟息毖 in Jinshu053 s0205; Han scholarly setting and Jin companion setting distinguish them despite Romanized Yang Bi.

Jinshu037 s0368 explicitly places 華恆 with 略 as the Minhuai prince’s selected East Palace companions in 元康初. Jinshu053 s0205 names 尚書令華暠息恆 and 泰息略 accompanying that prince. Same named pair, selection, court role and time supplies an explicit event bridge.

ZZT094 s0123h gives 華恆 as 金紫光祿大夫 attending the emperor alongside Xun Song and Xun Sui in the later Eastern Jin crisis. A career from the target’s earlier East Palace companionship is possible, but this packet contains no parentage, prior East Palace service, or explicit connecting appointment. Same name and plausible longevity alone are insufficient.

ZZT094 s0343d–s0343f names 太常華恆 and a former provincial rank judgment on Ren Rang; it does not connect him to Hua Gao’s son or the Minhuai prince. The long career is plausible, not proven. Preserve uncertainty.

Jinshu006 s0365 appoints 特進華恒 as 驃騎將軍/都督石頭水陸軍事 in Eastern Jin. 恒/恆 variation is compatible, but no shared family or East Palace episode links this later officer to the target. No contradiction warrants separation.

Jinshu031 s0266 mentions 故驃騎將軍華恒 with Xun Song/Xun Sui in genealogy compilation. This may bridge the later Eastern Jin records to one another, but still lacks a source bridge from that career cluster to Jinshu053’s Hua Gao son/East Palace companion. Do not use an inferred intermediate career as proof.
